moc: ruined Old St Paul's (burnt Gothic nave and square tower, no spire, no dome)

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A tall, slender, intact square tower with an arched belfry opening and a stepped top stands in the skyline at top right. It is not the ruined, squat Old St Paul's. No burnt Gothic nave is visible anywhere in the view.
ghi_chu.ly_do: In 1667 the landmark in this view should be the ruined Old St Paul's, a broad square central tower with no spire and a burnt nave. This tall, intact, Baroque-looking church tower looks like a later Wren or Hawksmoor design. It stands undamaged among ruins that the Great Fire of 1666 had destroyed.
